item.title: The Real Reason Bitcoin Is Stuck: Futures Trading Dwarfs ETFs 20-To-1
item.description: Bitcoin’s recent inability to escape a tight trading range may have less to do with spot Bitcoin ETF flows than many headlines suggest, and more to do with the derivatives complex still doing most of the heavy lifting, even as futures activity cools.
